summary: Defines BGP Link State extensions for advertising Flexible Algorithm definitions and related information. This lets a controller or other BGP-LS consumer learn about flexible algorithms that routers are running in OSPF and IS-IS.

eli5.summary: Routers have special routing rules in their own club. This lets an outside helper learn those rules by listening in through a shared messenger.
